title: Skull Walker in Vortex
description: A man in a dark suit, trench coat, and fedora stands atop a pile of large stone blocks and human skulls, holding a briefcase. He is positioned in front of a massive swirling vortex of orange and yellow light against a dark background.
prompt: A mysterious man wearing a fedora hat, dark trench coat, suit and boots stands atop a pile of crumbling stone blocks and human skulls while holding a black briefcase, dramatic low angle view, he is walking out of a giant swirling orange and yellow vortex portal in a dark abstract space, cinematic lighting, painterly brush strokes, dark moody atmosphere
